notes.title: BH Trials (Digger Parkour) 1.2.0
notes.content:
Put your ability with the controller to the test by driving a digger with no transmission, steering or brakes. You only can control the articulated arm. Use the two sticks of a gamepad just like in a real digger, in a weird sport of digger parkour.

Call some friends and try the couch co-op mode where you command a mechanical spider. Cooperation is essential as each player controls one of the four legs.

[previewyoutube=mo9AIrB1Gi8;full][/previewyoutube]

BH Trials 1.2.0 brings general improvements and adds support for portuguese and traditional chinese.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Access to leaderboards from the overworld
[*] Improved 4k support
[*] Improved localization + 2 new languages (portugues and traditional chinese)
[*] Solved issues with physics in some levels
[*] Small tweaks to some levels
[/list]

notes.title: The Arcade Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We are commited to making heavy machinery do weird things, and in this update we introduce [b]The Arcade[/b]

We have created two new minigames that will challenge your skill with the articulated arm. You will find them in the Overworld map, just look for geodesic structures!

[h3]A-1: Punching balls[/h3]
If it is lighted on, punch it! It is that easy. You have two and a half minutes to punch as many balls as you can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/4ff0e0c70fcd34c4555c45443b7b2d6526bccb35.jpg[/img]


[h3]A-2: Roll-a-ball[/h3]
Use the arm to hit balls into holes: Green holes give you 1 point, blue 2 points, and yellow, 3 points. The red hole gives 5 points, but it is particularly difficult to hit. This game is all about precision!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/54a89455bdce67d9600ce9b9ae495d4a6084e1e7.jpg[/img]


[h3]Other changes in 1.1[/h3]
[b]More music[/b]: A new spiffy track by enveloop.

[b]Better 4k support[/b]: All user interface elements have been updated with high resolution assets for a perfect visualization on 4k displays.

[b]Performance improvements[/b]: We have made several small performance improvements that contribute to a smoother experience, especially on lower-end machines.

[b]New cooperative map[/b]: We have redesigned the cooperative overworld to give you access to all levels from the same map, making it easier to navigate. You can unlock the different areas by beating the single player levels, and collecting the hidden miniature diggers.

notes.title: BH Trials 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Added toy to Trials 3-5. Now you can complete the "Saviour" achievement.
- Improved loading times
- Improved lighting on glass panels

notes.title: BH Trials 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]SAE vs ISO[/h1]
If you have experience with a real digger you might know that there is two different control schemes for the joysticks. BH Trials uses the SAE controls by default but now allows you to switch to the ISO scheme, so you can translate your real world skills into the game. 
You can select your preferred scheme in the gamepad options menu.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
New:
- Switch between SAE and ISO controls
- Added menu option to restore the digger to the last checkpoint

Changes:
- Small rework of the level Trials 1-6
- Added a checkpoint in Co-Op 1-3 at the top of the slope

Fixes:
- Fixed a problem with the camera misbehaving when the digger was upside-down
- Fixed a problem that made the screen to go darker
- Fixed missing material in Trials 1-4
- Fixed button at Trials 2-6 that did not always stayed activated
- Fixed a rendering problem when glass and fog overlaps
- Small fixes to the overworld

notes.title: BH Trials Beta 2 is here!
notes.content:
Learn how to drive a backhoe that has no transmission, steering, or brakes!

[h1]New levels[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/eeb82267c7f3abeeb2863a13bcc5420375ab0dd8.jpg[/img]

The game now features 10 increasingly difficult single-player levels. We've revised them all to reflect feedback from players.

There are also 6 cooperative levels for up to four players, each one taking control of one arm of a four legged spider-hoe. The first level is available at the beginning of the game -collect the digger toys hidden in each trial to unlock the rest. 

You can now play with friends online thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]Steam Remote Play Together[/url]. Only one copy of BH Trials is needed.

You can also play the cooperative levels alone, switching control between the arms. If you have already mastered the single player levels, this is the challenge for you :)

[h1]Ghosts[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/59b220549202c16c8ab1e59588dd869750b97be8.jpg[/img]

Your best time's performance is saved as a ghost digger that will appear as you play. Getting the three stars is a path of self improvement, and the ghost will help you know if you are doing better.

[h1]Music[/h1]
We now have all new gameplay music composed by José Luis González Castro expressly for the game.

[h1]Controls[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/8d9e2ee6bcb1721fa689f93ef0a569e89edf5b32.jpg[/img]

We now support mouse and keyboard, gamepads (XBox, XBox One, PS3 and PS4), and the Steam Controller. You can even play the game in your mobile phone with Steam Remote.

We've also added experimental support for the Steel Battalion Controller, a massive dual-stick controller for the original XBox that we've brought back to life. Learn more about it on the [url=https://hackaday.com/2019/09/13/steel-battalion-controller-grows-up-and-gets-a-job/]hackaday article[/url].

[h1]Languages[/h1]
BH Trials is now localized to english, español, deutsch, français, and italiano, 日本語, 한국어 and 汉语.

[h1]Discord server[/h1]
We want to know about your experience and what do you think of BH Trials. Talk to us and the other beta players in the [url=https://discord.gg/A5zHY6k]discord server[/url].

notes.title: Take part in the BH Trials closed beta
notes.content:
Register to join the beta starting July 16th. You only need to fill the form [url=https://forms.gle/hET81EQMkBsFP89PA]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34905249/ac556ed14498eb6bfc15767f1a0c5d4e5936fbae.png[/img]

Haven’t you heard of BH Trials before? BH Trials is a skill, physics-based game where you control a backhoe with no transmission, steering, or brakes. You must learn to move and  take on the obstacles on your path using only the backhoe’s arms.

BH Trials also features a cooperative mode where up to four players control a four-legged backhoe.

Join us to be the first to try this innovative game!
